# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Scientific-Owner Provisional Choice 3 Direction

Date: `2026-08-31`

Status: **owner Stage A direction; provisional preference for Choice 3;
ODQ-001 remains open and no recurrence is approved**

Direction ID: `SCI-FRUIT-DIR-2026-08-31-CHOICE-3-STUDY`

## Owner Direction

The scientific owner agrees that the recovered historical recurrence is not
known to be the best recurrence for the intended FRUIT science. The owner
therefore provisionally favors Choice 3: develop an intentionally new,
versioned recurrence rather than making historical behavior normative solely
because it is historical.

The recovered historical recurrence remains the mandatory v0.1 compatibility
reference and scientific control. This direction does not presume that the
historical method is inferior, and it does not approve additive accumulation
or any other candidate transition.

## Meaning Of The Provisional Choice

Choice 3 is provisionally selected as the method-development category, not as
a completed scientific-method decision. Before ODQ-001 can close, Stage A must
define the scientific estimand and owner-approved meaning of "better," then
state the candidate transition and its expected differences from the
historical control.

The success criteria must address at least:

- transfer response and null space;
- source-flux and morphology recovery;
- extended-emission recovery over an explicit validity domain;
- noise and uncertainty behavior;
- convergence and stability;
- dependence on masks, learned state, and stopping rules; and
- exact-restart reproducibility.

Any accepted new law must be identified as an intentional method change and
must state its consequences for historical products, checkpoints, map-only
seeds, lineage, downstream consumers, and coexistence or supersession of the
historical method. The historical control remains available as a fallback if
no candidate new law satisfies the eventual acceptance criteria.

## Decisions That Remain Open

- `ODQ-001A`: the complete scientific identity of the versioned accepted
  feedback state `F_k`;
- `ODQ-001B`: the exact transition `U_k` in
  `F_{k+1}=U_k(F_k,R_{k+1})`;
- `ODQ-001C`: the existence and scientific or diagnostic status of update
  contributions;
- `ODQ-001D`: the causal restart state and bounded retention policy;
- whether historical and new methods coexist or one supersedes the other; and
- the exact validation design and acceptance thresholds.

This direction authorizes no Stage B dispatch, implementation, algorithm
change, numerical route, production use, additive law, increment calibration,
or unbounded intermediate retention.
